rate-curve.alt: A curve of dye depth in an agar cube against time, rising steeply at first and flattening. A straight line from 0 to 10 minutes shows the average rate, 3.6 mm in 10 min or 0.36 mm/min. A short steep tangent near 1 minute and a shallow one near 9 minutes show that the instantaneous rate falls over time.
